_comment: The grwire.v1 wire format, in the one place all three realms read it from.
The binary frame header exists in Rust (grwire/src/proto.rs), in JavaScript
(runner/src/grwire_worker.js) and the shared-memory control block exists in
JavaScript and C++ (blocks/src/grwire_source.hpp). None of those three can
import from another, so each hard-codes the layout and a test asserts it
against this file. Change a number here and three tests fail at once, which
_control_comment: The shared-memory control block between grwire_source.hpp (C++) and
grwire_worker.js. Index order IS the struct field order; adding a field
means editing both files in the same order and bumping words here.

_stage_comment: Three positional live gain slots, in tenths of a dB. Slot n addresses the
n-th element of whatever the radio reported in `opened.info.gain_elements`,
so one block serves a HackRF (LNA/AMP/VGA), an Airspy (LNA/MIX/VGA) and an
RTL-SDR (TUNER alone) without naming any of them. stage_unset means the
stage is not driven, because 0 dB is a legitimate gain.
